items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: I recorded a couple of very, very old songs with a legendary figure down in Nashville by the name of Mac Wiseman

ctx.x: Yeah, and when I was there, I decided -- a friend of mine has a small country label, and we decided we'd do a single. And I recorded a couple of very, very old songs with a legendary figure down in Nashville by the name of Mac Wiseman, who's a very strong influence and has been for many years in the bluegrass field.
How do you spell his name?
